label: The miter
subgoals: Connect corresponding inputs of the two circuits
XOR each pair of outputs and OR the results
Count the input vectors on which the miter is 1

label: Several outputs
subgoals: XOR every output pair and OR them into one miter output
Take the union of the per-output difference sets
Report the first satisfying assignment as the counterexample

label: Making the proof scale
subgoals: Count the miter nodes as both cones plus the output XORs and OR
Merge proven internal equivalences from the inputs upward
Use sequential equivalence checking when registers have moved
